title: Ransom Note Construction
description: Given two lowercase strings `ransomNote` and `magazine`, return `true` if `ransomNote` can be constructed by using the letters from `magazine` and `false` otherwise. Each letter in `magazine` can only be used once in `ransomNote`.
constraints: ransomNote and magazine consist of lowercase English letters.
hints: Count the frequency of each of the 26 lowercase letters in magazine.
Decrement counts for each character in ransomNote; if any count drops below zero, return false.

examples.explanation: "ab" only contains one 'a', but "aa" needs two.
